character_data.text:
神秘学家混血种艺术品，展出于20世纪30年代，参展时长11年，诞生自7月14日夏。展出地点为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国伦敦郡。

尺寸：59 1/16×55 1/8×23 5/8in.

character_data.title: 业余手工制品
character_data.text:
受访者从回收的碎布条中拣出符合其喜好的部分，再加工制成的发饰。
缝纫技术是当时几乎每个儿童都会掌握的技能，受访者在这方面要低于平均水平。

character_data.title: 晾衣杆兼叫醒器
character_data.text:
受访者爱用的Y字型金属长杆，用途的多寡取决于想象力的丰富程度。
据受访者称，因为其多次闯祸，已被禁止在室内和狭窄空间挥舞晾衣杆。

character_data.title: “最好的靴子”
character_data.text:
受访者最好的且唯一的靴子，她的姐姐收到新鞋作为生日礼物后，将这双靴子送给了她。
受访者很享受这双偏大的靴子带来的宽松与自由感，她立志要在靴子合脚前多穿几次。

character_data.title: 儿童与青少年
character_data.text:
家里并不富裕，所以由孩子承担家务，替忙碌工作的大人分担劳动，这是非常合理的行为。而当大人的收入不足以维系整个家庭的生活所需，就让孩子发挥自己的动手能力，做些小玩意儿来补贴家用，也是无可奈何。
可等到工业革命将每个人的家和工厂绑在一起，问题便发生了。
这一问题从十八世纪起就存在于不列颠，一直到1933年的《儿童及青少年法案》通过才得到解决。
现在孩子们不能去工厂干活了，那么格罗夫家的日常开支怎么办呢？
“去做个叫醒工吧，至少能自己赚自己的午餐钱。”
这是个还算不错的差事，可以在城里到处跑，见识很多人，还能抬起头敲别人家的窗户，而且总好过擦皮鞋。

character_data.title: 有问必有答
character_data.text:
“你知道么？你的工作非常重要。如果你不工作的话，人们就没法按时起床。”
又来了，她又要开始唠叨了，这会持续很久。
“在要工作的日子睡了懒觉是很可怕的事情，会被鞭子抽，还会被扣工钱。扣了工钱就没有钱买面包，你也就填不饱肚子，只能去地里抓虫子吃了。”
她在说什么呢？好难懂。
“我知道的，你一定有很多问题，为什么要干这个，再干那个，为什么一定要早起，晚一些不行么？如果工作赚钱是为了换面包，那面包房要钱做什么呢？”
我懂了，总之她特别困惑，我懂了。
“抱歉，我也不知道答案。但答案一定是存在的，如果不知道答案，为什么大人们都从不问问题呢？”
抱歉，小姑娘，虽然你很困惑，但我无能为力。
“所以明天也要叫醒我，好么？”
太阳早就落山了，小姑娘，该合眼了。
“晚安，奥利，明早见。”
“咯咯哒。”

character_data.title: 飞行的秘诀
character_data.text:
白雪松：考虑到你所在的时代和你的年纪，能像你这样保持童真可以说非常难得。
纸信圈儿：爸爸和妈妈也总说我该快些长大了，但我至今没抓到诀窍，一年还是只能长一岁。
白雪松：我想他们指的是心理上的成熟。
纸信圈儿：我认为应该有人把成长的诀窍公开，比如印到报纸上。
白雪松：这是个我也不曾想到的有趣议题，或许可以为此开一期专栏，就叫作成长的诀窍。
纸信圈儿：那么我也要分享我的诀窍。
白雪松：那一定会是充满奇思妙想的诀窍。
纸信圈儿：我可以分享飞行的诀窍，其实很简单的。
白雪松：为了防止有年轻读者模仿，接下来的内容我可能不会公开。

character_data.title: 衔春之燕
character_data.text:
一只被春风托住的纸燕，被衔住的报春花似乎在微风中翩翩抖动，迎风的样子与受访者颇为相似。
在采访期间，笔者注意到了受访者斗篷下的小动作，也许这就是纸燕能够飞行的秘诀。

character_data.title: 满载的藤篮
character_data.text:
塞满信件的藤篮。在它上方，作为动力源的金属制小飞机在采访过程中也未曾停歇。我们注意到，其上附着了某种与受访者佩戴的基金会特别徽章相呼应的神秘术。
“那是用来防止我们走失或迷路的，不过我没有用上过。”受访者自信满满地说，“即使迷路了，我也有其他办法。”

character_data.title: 藤蔓邮差包
character_data.text:
装满了春天的邮差包，缠绕其上的藤蔓与受访者一样活泼又坚强。
受访者打开背包，欣然为笔者展示了奇异的青蛙、白色公鸡的羽毛、姐姐的签到卡等足够彰显当地风土人情的物品。她还非常热情地询问了笔者是否想吃一颗糖。

character_data.title: “天空的邀约”
character_data.text:
小型无人直升机上常见的飞行装置，空气动力学的杰出体现，使用时需注意避开鸟类。
为了安全起见，受访者使用的是动力减配版，但她沉浸于得到飞行许可的喜悦中，对此并不在意。

character_data.title: 啁啾表式一体通讯器
character_data.text:
以啁啾表为核心的便携式通讯设备，具有录音、通讯、报时等功能，精度达到原子时水平，需要经常检查、保养零件，以提供最准时的报晓服务。
受访者表示，本设备还支持报晓音频定制服务，包含各种鸟鸣声、猫狗叫声，还有来自妈妈的、温柔或充满怒火的叫喊声——“保证让您满意！”

character_data.title: 新工业匠心
character_data.text:
模仿手工艺质感制作的金属电镀头饰，从小鸟身上隐约的模线可以看出，这份复古的韵味依然是工业的批量产物。
但，在模型与涂装上还原出匠人的手工痕迹可不是一件容易的事！谁也不能说这是一件没有匠心的作品。

I don't know what else I can do.#16.3

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 现在，我可以吹出让两个人飘起来的风了，维尔汀，你想试试飞的感觉吗？就一小会儿？#0
character_voice.encontent: I've figured out how to blow the wind to carry both of us at the same time. Would you like to fly, Vertin? Just for a little while?#0

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 人们有时候放飞鸽子，有时候放飞气球，#0|特别在出太阳的时候，飞行路线很容易变得拥堵……应该有一个“放飞预报”！#4.1
character_voice.encontent: People send out doves and balloons on sunny days, but they never think about where they're goin'. #0|They might jam up the whole sky! That's why I've been flyerin' about havin' a "release forecast"!#5.35

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 如果剧院的演员开始化妆，“未来”他们就可能表演。#0|如果展览馆的讲解员走在一群人前方，“未来”他们就可能介绍展品。#6.65|但机器人把“未来”变得复杂多了——人们“现在”不做这些事了，却不知道还要做些什么。#12.3|我没法推测“未来”，大家都还弄不清楚“现在”是什么样呢。#20.15
character_voice.encontent: If actors are puttin' on makeup, they're probably goin' to perform on the stage in the "future." #0|If a museum guide steps in front of a group of people, they're probably goin' to start a speech in the "future."#6.05|But now that robots do all those things for us, what're we supposed to do?#12.6|How can we predict the future if we can't even figure out what's goin' on right now?#17.1

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 唔……你还站在这里，但是你也不在这里。维尔汀，你的灵魂是跑去哪片神经网络了吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Hmm ... You're here, but your soul ain't. Why's that? Where'd it go, Vertin? Into a neural network, or somethin'?#0

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 我正在练习长距离飞行——虽然这里不够大，#0|但假如我一直不落地，我也能在房间里飞出联盟号-花岗岩大桥那么长的距离。#4.05|房子的大小并不能限制我飞多远，我想证明这个。#11.45
character_voice.encontent: I'm practicin' my long-distance flyin' skills. This room ain't that big, #0|but as long as I keep my feet off the ground, I bet I could fly even further than the length of the Soyuz-Granit bridge! #4.75|I'll prove I can fly for as long as I want, don't matter how small the room is.#11.6

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 大家有了更丰富的早安问候语，不只是“谢谢”和“滚开”，#0|还有“他们又研发新型机器人了？”和“拉菲克，把这个小女孩赶走！”#4.55
character_voice.encontent: People's mornin' greetings have really changed. Other than the good old "thank you" and "get lost," #0|now there's "They invented a new type of robot?" and "Rafik, get this girl away!"#6.65

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 【露西】“已接收信号，预计录音返回时，我已完成‘起床’。”#0|露西女士真准时——噢，维尔汀，你也在。我正试着用啁啾表做叫醒工，#5.25|这样叫醒大家比敲窗子还要好玩！多亏了X先生的改造，明早你也来加入吗？#11.7
character_voice.encontent: Lucy: "Signal received. Estimated wakeup time: upon the return of the recording."#0|Madam Lucy certainly is timely! Oh, mornin', Vertin. Thanks to Mr. X, I can use Chirpers to do my knocker-upperin' now. #6.15|It seems loads more fun than doin' it by hand! Want to see it for yourself tomorrow mornin'?#15.5

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 啁啾表至少有两种催眠方式——#0|把它当成一个钟摆，盯住它，或者还有种更好的，像这个……#3.45
character_voice.encontent: There's two ways Chirpers can help you sleep. #0|One is to watch them swing like a mind-controllin' pendulum. But I prefer the second, which is ... #2.9

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 我还不想睡觉。我猜，现在天黑并不是因为太阳下山了，#0|而是因为一座比切洛梅还大得多的飞行平台路过了这里。#6.2|这是很有可能的，我应该等它离开后再盖上被子。#11.8
character_voice.encontent: I don't want to go to bed yet. I know it's dark outside, #0|but it's probably just a giant platform flyin' by—a much bigger one than Chelomey. #4.15|So I ain't goin' to sleep until I figure out what it is.#10.4

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 这是个拒绝丢失记忆的好办法，把生活放在啁啾表的“波浪”里，一遍遍地听——#0|我们再也不用费力地回想细节了，#7.55|但这样究竟是更容易记住事情，还是更容易忘记？#10.45
character_voice.encontent: These Chirpers are proper nifty. You can pack up your memories in their "waves" and never forget a thing—#0|don't have to hold all the little bits in your brain no more. #6.8|But, uh, does that mean it's easier to remember things, or that it's easier to forget them?#10.05

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 这些扇叶替代了布条与小纸屑，让我能看见风。#0|我照着它们，把碎纸条做成了风车的样子。#5|可我一旦把风车塞进口袋，它就又变回了碎纸条。#9.45|所以它们是不能相互替代的。#14.05
character_voice.encontent: These fan blades on my wrists show me the wind, sort of like the bits of paper I used to use. #0|So, I thought I'd make a pinwheel out of the paper instead.  #5.7|But I don't think they liked it, 'cause when I put it in my pocket, it broke all to pieces. #9.3|So I promised them I won't replace them with nothin', no matter what.#15.25

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 我混入过“鸨式”机器人的送货队列，跟着它们降落在一片农田里，不小心睡着了。#0|我醒来的时候，一只“熊蜂”提着我。#7.4|在那时，我感觉自己找到了鸟群，飞行不再孤独了。#11.3
character_voice.encontent: I sneakily joined a Drofa transport once—flew all the way to this big farm with it, but I accidentally fell asleep after we landed. #0|When I woke up, a Bumblebee was holdin' me in the sky, with Drofas all around. #9.3|Suddenly, I weren't flyin' alone no more. It was like I'd found my flock.#16

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 听说，“综合教育”实现后，学校就会关门。#0|那我可能会失去我最喜欢的游戏——把课本的每个字母空隙填满色。#4.05|不过我已经想好了下一个游戏——把报纸的每个字母空隙填满色！#10.8
character_voice.encontent: They say that there'll be no more schools when "poly-education" comes true. #0|But then, my favorite game will be gone too—colorin' in the gaps between letters on textbooks! #4.2|Not to worry, I've come up with a new game: colorin' in the gaps between letters on newspapers!#10.6

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 愿意仔细听我提问的人很少，但机器人总是有问必答。#0|当然，维尔汀也不赖，你回答问题的表情，有时候和机器人一样稳定。#5.3
character_voice.encontent: Not many people properly listen when I ask things, but robots always do. #0|'Course, you're not so bad yourself, Vertin. And your face is sometimes just as steady as a robot's.#6.15

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 我也想命令机器人。我想命令它们别对我说“不许做这个，也不许做那个！”#0
character_voice.encontent: I want to give commands to robots too. Then I can forbid them from sayin', "Don't do this!" and "Don't do that!"#0

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 笃笃骨也夸赞了我的新衣服，她说：“究竟是谁还嫌你不够像个风筝？”#0|她是怎么知道我有“线”的呢？#6.9|神鹫的控制员明明说那是“无线”电。#9.8|“无线”电不会不够长，所以我还是很自在的一只小风筝。#13.95
character_voice.encontent: Ms. Willow just loved my new outfit! I think her exact words were, "Who on earth decided to dress you up like even more of a kite?" #0|But, wait ... kites need a wire, don't they? #9.95|The Kondor pilot said what I have is a wireless ... somethin' ... device. #14.35|Anyway, it means I can go wherever I want. So even if I am a kite, I'm a free-flyin' kite.#19.35

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 【维尔汀的录音】“不要哭泣，把种子种下吧，我们会收获硕果。”#0|在你讲述雨幕舞台里的冒险时，我录下了这句话。#4.55|我思考了很久，还是觉得，也许我们可以考虑用眼泪来浇灌种子——#9.75|眼泪不哭出来的话，就会在身体里越积越多，我试过。#17.6
character_voice.encontent: Vertin's recording: "Don't cry. If we sow our seeds today, we'll reap a bountiful harvest in the future."#0|I recorded this when you were tellin' us about your adventure in the Stage in the Rain. #6.35|I thought and I thought about it, but I still think we can water the seeds with our tears. #10.8|If we don't cry them out, they'll just gather all up in our bodies like a big river. Trust me, I know.#16.65

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 我原本以为，连接到聚合物网络……就可以让所有“为什么”都得到答案——那很好，#0|但是又有些奇怪，我也说不清是为什么。#8.3|不过，我现在搞明白了，得到答案是为了提出更多的、新的“为什么”。#13.05
character_voice.encontent: At first, I thought the Polymer Network would answer all the whys in the world and that would be it, #0|but ... somethin' didn't feel quite right about that. #7.1|Well, I've figured it out now. The reason we answer all our whys is so we could ask more whys, 'cause there are always more whys to ask!#11.1

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 这里也需要语音记录吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Do we need to record the sound here too?#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 我应该先飞起来。#0
character_voice.encontent: Better get off the ground first.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 风——快过来！#0
character_voice.encontent: Oi, wind! Over here!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我正在听。#0
character_voice.encontent: I'm listenin'.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 我来录这个！#0
character_voice.encontent: I'll record this!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 我会离云彩更近——#0
character_voice.encontent: Closer to the clouds!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 跳进风里！#0
character_voice.encontent: Leap into the wind!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 向上、向上——#0
character_voice.encontent: Up, up, and higher!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 不愉快的声音！#0
character_voice.encontent: What a nasty noise!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 太大声了……#0
character_voice.encontent: It's too loud!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 这是你的心声——还是梦话？#0
character_voice.encontent: Is this what you really think, or just sleep-talk?#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: *一段卡顿的录音*#0
character_voice.encontent: *a choppy recording*#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.encontent: "No-Fly Zone"?#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content:
“胜利”很重要，#0|现在表盘听到了，齿轮也听到了。#1.3|
很快，我们就可以一遍遍地听到了！#4.1
character_voice.encontent: Ain't nothin' more important than a victory message. #0|We need to make sure the dial and the gears listen and remember, #3.45|so that we can hear it more and more often!#7.15

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 风有时候送来问题，有时候送来答案，它们都是礼物，我都收下了，#0|我相信我会这样找到“成长的诀窍”。#7
character_voice.encontent: Sometimes the wind brings me questions, and sometimes answers. #0|But, either way, I think they're like big presents all wrapped up in bows—'cause they're where the key to growin' up is hidden.#4.95

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 这对翅膀让我变沉了，但飞起来时，我却变得更轻。#0|如果“长大”就是把我装进更大更重的身体里，却可以飞得更高，那么“长大”可能也很好？#5.6
character_voice.encontent: These wings are proper heavy. But, funny thing is, instead of draggin' me down, they help me fly easier. #0|Is that what growin' up does, too? Like ... livin' in a bigger body, but flyin' even higher? Guess it's not as terrible as I thought.#8.75

character_voice.name: 主页交互触发
character_voice.content: 计划是——我来抓住风，你来抓住我，对吧？#0
character_voice.encontent: So the plan is: I'll catch the wind, and you'll catch me. Got it?#0

character_voice.name: 交互成功
character_voice.content: 如果你不想吃到头发，就别讲话。你可以笑一笑，像这样——#0
character_voice.encontent: Better keep your mouth shut if you don't want a mouthful of hair. But you can do a smile—like this!#0

character_voice.name: 未交互
character_voice.content: 噢——看来你想先摘掉帽子，你是对的。#0
character_voice.encontent: Oh, you want to take off your hat first? Right. I'd have done that too.#0

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 完美降落！既没有撞倒桌子，也没有撞倒椅子，更没有撞倒维尔汀！#9
character_voice.encontent: Perfect landin'! No tables, chairs, or Vertin was knocked down! Hehe!#9

skin.name: 明日的春风
skin.skinDescription: 当她的春风刮起，悲伤的余烬都将被吹散。
skin.skinStory:
“她走了，已经3个月没有回信了。”纸信圈儿跑下台阶时，听见老妇人向屋内说道。她顿住脚，回头看见门边歪斜的信箱。信箱上裂了条大缝，因此，这家老妇人总守在门边等她。
战地邮票从来都不充裕，没有信来才是常事，纸信圈儿见过太多次类似的失望。小信使想了想，又敲敲门将一朵报春花送给了略带失望的老人。
“送给我的？谢谢你……孩子。”老妇人拄着拐杖，挪出房门，“我在等一个消息，像这朵报春花似的消息。”
小信使仰起头：“您是说……？”
“战争和冬天一样难熬，但愿和平能和春天一同到来。”
“我明白了。春天来临的时候，我保证，您会很快、很快地知道的。传递春天只需要一阵风……我很擅长那个。”

skin.name: 原子时报晓
skin.skinDescription: 这里记录了72种常见的鸟类叫声，致力为切洛梅带来充满自然气息的报晓服务。
skin.skinStory:
已发现啁啾表

*杂乱的声音*
“唔、我不小心碰开了一块啁啾表，所以应该录点什么……我现在飞得很高，但是这里的‘熊蜂’和‘蜜蜂’们飞得更高——它们的速度又非常快！‘熊蜂’可以把我提起来，‘蜜蜂’不能，我想是因为它们更小。”

*嗡嗡的螺旋桨转动声*
“我跟着返回的‘蜜蜂’飞到‘蜂房’附近，它看起来只是个冷冰冰的铁匣子。一个‘蜂房’里有多少只‘蜜蜂’呢？我觉得，它们应该有个排班表，确保每只‘蜜蜂’都能出来飞。”
“前面是‘捕风网’！机器人告诉我，风可以变成‘能量’。我的翅膀和‘捕风网’的翅膀有一样的形状，所以我也使用了风的‘能量’。”

*鸟鸣声*
“我录下了不同小鸟的叫声，刚才的是第54种，这对我的叫醒工作有帮助。明天要用……云雀，还是夜莺？我得花点时间做决定。”

1231012.content: 在伦敦偶尔有人会上街游行，要求让小孩子上学。
维尔汀，你上过学么？学校会让孩子做什么？
逃跑……我懂。有的时候遇到找不出答案的问题，我就会飞去另一个地方。
或者躲起来，躲起来总是有用的。我会把头埋进洗衣筐里，大人们就会以为我是一堆脏衣服。
你的衣服很干净，所以不能这么做，但你还是可以试试，衣服堆里其实很舒服。
那学校里一定有非常重要的，只有小孩子才能做的工作。
可能和当叫醒工一样重要，否则不会有那么多小孩子想要上学的。
我？我应该长大了，不用上学了，爸爸是这么说的。

1232012.content: （她正默默地跟着你，一言不发。）
来到这里后不用工作，我变得很闲。
我听说这里的人的主要工作是做你的跟班，所以我正在适应。
没关系，不用给我工钱，因为这份工作很有趣。
（她展开双臂，模仿着鸟儿的飞行动作离开了。）

1233012.speaker: 纸信圈儿
1233012.content: 你看起来很像小号的福葛先生。

1233012.speaker: 雾行者
1233012.content: 叫我小福葛确实算不上错……你认识我父亲？

1233012.speaker: 纸信圈儿
1233012.content: 我帮助过福葛先生的工作，他有份很伟大的工作，就和我的叫醒工作一样重要。

1233012.speaker: 纸信圈儿
1233012.content: 你听起来像是牙疼，或许你真的牙疼？我可以把牙仙女士介绍给你，她很擅长应付牙疼。

1233012.speaker: 雾行者
1233012.content: 不，我只是在哀叹，哀叹连你这个年纪的女孩都在谈论工作。

1233012.speaker: 雾行者
1233012.content: 哎……伦敦政府的良心想必早就被煤烟熏黑了。
